about_the_game:
Get your style on before you get your game on

Ready to get your Splitgate journey started? This Starter Pack comes with three assault rifle weapon skins, a special portal skin, and 500 bonus Splitcoin.

Pack includes:

- 500 Splitcoin

- Starting Lineup Tempo

- Starting Lineup Synapse

- Starting Lineup Trailblazer

- Realm Warp Portal

Splitcoin is the in-game currency that can be used to obtain in-game content for use in Splitgate 2.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-6100 / Core™ i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 or AMD Radeon™ RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit or Windows® 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-6600K / Core™ i7-4770 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 1400
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
